primary_question: With native continuation determinism and active-response transport validity both fixed, does serial native-TTS fair alternation reduce another response's first-audio latency without changing any transcript, text, prompt, cursor, or PCM byte?

experiment.name: post-determinism-first-audio-fair-alternation

profile_before_candidate.conclusion: Serial continuation-first admission remains the dominant first-audio residual; native compute and public forwarding are small by comparison.

experiment.single_candidate: For serial native TTS only, alternate FIFO first-audio legs (:tts:0 and :tts) with the FIFO continuation/ordinary class whenever both are queued. Never preempt running compute, reorder within a class, enable batching, or change request bytes, sampling, cancellation, deadlines, or queue limits.
experiment.historical_disposition: Task #55 fair-priority remains rejected under its old no-fix contract. Its latency numbers are not reused. This is a new experiment justified by the fresh profile and made testable by the accepted Task #59 continuation determinism fix.
experiment.ordering_rule: SplitMix64 selected fair-alternation first and ABAB interleaving. Both policies have two fresh complete runs; paired A/B comparisons use equal logical arm/session/round keys, and same-policy A/A comparisons independently require exact media identity.
required_correctness: All seven R4 arms and all delayed barge-in, echo-suppression, and double-talk controls pass every run.
Two independent fresh-process raw verifiers produce byte-identical reports for every run; every self-excluded manifest passes twice.
The final candidate also passes the real six-session reconnect/retry/immediate-barge network gate and the 29-session exact delayed-reader public PCM gate.
ACK-anchored cancel-to-silence is digital timed virtual playback only; physical playback and perceptual/acoustic quality remain NOT_COVERED.

vlm.sampling: native deterministic defaults; no request sampling override

topology.observer_rule: byte-preserving multipart forwarding; record original monotonic_ns before and after forwarding
topology.forbidden_resources: Do not use GPU 7, any other resident GPU, or the resident service; bind only ephemeral loopback ports.

short.source: accepted Task 41 R3 retained recorded microphone WAV
short.retained_cold_transcript: Uh huh. Oh yeah, yeah. He.

long.source: existing 16 kHz mono PCM16 English ASR recording used by the native validation gate
long.purpose: exercise a different prompt and measure actual first-segment length; the R1 zh_16 candidate was rejected prospectively after an empty repeated-turn ASR final

input_schedule.interleaving: SplitMix64 seed derives a fresh session start permutation and jitter for every measured round
input_schedule.serial_rule: the next turn starts only after the previous response completes and its final playback ACK is accepted
input_schedule.concurrent_rule: all sessions in a round have active sockets and start in the seeded order; no failed or slow response is dropped

required_observations: ASR audio submit, native final completion, public ASR final and speech-stop timestamps
VLM submit, first/last native text, native prefill/decode/elapsed, prefix reuse and public text arrival
actual first TTS text, first-segment availability, TTS submit, first native PCM and first public WS audio
TTS native compute-to-first-PCM and per-leg stream/terminal waveform identity
raw PCM bytes and hashes, raw WS bytes and arrival timestamps, all terminal and ACK events
median, p95, q1, q3, IQR, MAD, min, max and every Tukey outlier for every stage metric
cold prefix_reused=0 for every cold request; warm measured reuse is reported exactly and is not fabricated

first new-speech append to cancellation including VAD, signed speech-started notification to cancellation, accepted playback ACK to cancellation, and client receive cancellation to timed virtual playback silence
source, harness, observer, binary, model and fixture SHA-256 identities
final /health in_flight=0, owned-process exit and assigned-GPU idle restoration

after_measured_arms: delayed barge-in after a positive acknowledged cursor
simultaneous double-talk in both echo modes
required: one terminal callback kind per response

ab_acceptance.pairing: arm, fixture, measured repetition and logical session; warmups and deliberate cancellations are excluded from primary latency pairs but retained
ab_acceptance.quality: paired ASR transcript, full response text, prompt history, first TTS text/cursors and concatenated PCM SHA-256 must all match; both same-policy A/A pairs and both cross-policy A/B pairs require exact equality with every miss retained
ab_acceptance.candidate_improvement: both independent A/B primary medians decrease by at least 20 percent with no hidden samples
ab_acceptance.guardrails: serial-cold-short median regression no more than 5 percent; concurrent-cold-short p95 regression no more than 5 percent; no protocol or quality regression in any arm
ab_acceptance.stability: Use population standard deviation / arithmetic mean. Both serial-cold-short arms require CV <= 0.10 or the quiet window repeats. Concurrent CV is reported but not gated because seeded admission order intentionally creates heterogeneous queue positions; every concurrent sample remains visible.
ab_acceptance.no_fix_path: If exact identity, same-policy repeatability, correctness, or any latency guardrail fails, retain precise evidence and make no latency runtime change.
